plugins.name: ai-advisors
plugins.description: See how AI answer engines represent your brand. Reads AI visibility, citations, AEO audit findings and AI-referred traffic from your AI-Advisors workspace, and turns them into a prioritized list of fixes.

skills.name: aeo-audits
skills.description: Interpret and act on AI-Advisors AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) audit findings - crawler access, server-side rendering, structured data and entity graphs, content freshness and direct answers. Use when asked why a site is not cited by AI engines, how to make a site retrievable by AI crawlers, what an AEO score means, or which audit findings to fix first.
headings: The four failure modes, in the order they matter
2. The content was not in the HTML
4. The page did not answer the question

skills.name: ai-search-visibility
skills.description: Read and interpret AI search visibility data from AI-Advisors - which tracked prompts mention or cite the brand across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity, who wins the answers you lose, and what the numbers do and do not prove. Use when asked about AI visibility, brand mentions in AI answers, citation share, share of voice, or competitor presence in AI search.

skills.name: ai-traffic-and-crawlers
skills.description: Interpret AI-Advisors traffic data - visits referred from AI assistants, AI crawler activity, paid versus organic AI traffic, and how AI numbers reconcile against Google Search Console, Bing and GA4. Use when asked how much traffic AI is sending, whether AI crawlers are visiting a site, why AI numbers disagree with analytics, or whether AI traffic converts.
headings: The structural fact about crawler data

skills.name: ai-advisors-setup
skills.description: Set up and verify the AI-Advisors connection - create the API token, configure it, and confirm the tools respond. Use when the plugin is first installed, when a tool returns an authentication or rate-limit error, or when the user asks how to connect AI-Advisors.

commands.name: aeo-fixes
commands.description: Turn the latest AEO audit into a prioritized, ordered fix list with the reason each item matters.

commands.name: visibility-report
commands.description: Pull a current AI search visibility report for a tracked website and summarize what is winning, what is losing, and why.

commands.name: weekly-read
commands.description: Summarize what changed in AI search for a tracked website this week and what to focus on next.
